verdict.rationale: Per its own pages, Delaware lets founders reserve a name online, and annual report and franchise tax filing and payment are required to be done online through a keyless portal. Formation itself has no native transactional flow: founders fill PDF forms and submit them through the Document Filing and Certificate Request Service upload, or by fax or mail, with registered agents acting as the de facto service layer. Missing for 10: a native online formation flow, documented online payment of formation fees, and hands-on corroboration that the formation upload completes end-to-end.
